protocol: 5 personas judged the diverse council slate (top-2 per arch family, 14 candidates) in-context under the NEW Stage-2 rubric: Impact 30 / Meta Tooling 25 / Tech Depth 20 / Demo 25. Concept-level novelty re-checked by each persona (HF/GitHub lexical check already passed 146/150).

finalists.idea: Thikana — region-addressed operations memory for solar rooftop fleets (A20 segment-as-index + W17 end-to-end ops, hierarchical crew, solar installers)
Insurance claims desks via object-centric episodic memory (A13 + W17, supervisor swarm)
Chem-warehouse safety via geometry-aware segmentation embeddings (A03 + W17, supervisor swarm)
Self-improving QA loop via synthetic-contrastive loop (A23 + just-in-time dashboard, adversarial debate, food SMEs / chem)
Packaging line film-session via mixture-of-role-based-experts (A02 + footage-to-insight, supervisor swarm)

personas.name: The Judge (rubric literalist)
personas.note: C1 tops every axis the new weights reward; Impact 30% favors a real sector (solar) with mandated photo workflows.

personas.name: The Builder (solo 8-day feasibility)
personas.note: C1 needs no training runs; CRUD + SAM calls + overlay UI. C4's self-training loop is a day-6 risk.

personas.name: The Skeptic (novelty / anti-generic)
personas.note: Claims-AI is a crowded startup space (concept collision). C3 is most conference-novel; C1 verified original and concept-distinct from plain solar-defect classifiers.

personas.name: The Crowd (demo wow / virality)
personas.note: 'What changed in region 3 since Tuesday?' answered live with masks is an instant-wow beat.

personas.name: The Mentor (user-profile fit: models, images, videos, research)
personas.note: C4 is the most 'model-building' idea; but C1 can absorb the geometry-aware embedding (user's named arch) and an open-weight classifier, so it keeps research depth.

decision: CHAMPION: C1 — Thikana. Spec merges C3's geometry-aware mask-manifold embedding (user-named architecture) and C4's synthetic-contrastive loop (light version, Muse Image hard negatives) INTO C1, plus an open-weight region classifier on Baseten (Best-Open-Weight bonus) and hierarchical role-crew (Best-Agentic bonus).

rejected_notes.C2: concept-level collision risk: claims-automation startups exist (Tractable/Salient-class); user's bar is 'not done before'.
rejected_notes.C5: strong, kept as runner-up; sports-flavored framing must be scrubbed; packaging narrower than solar fleets.
rejected_notes.arena_top: arena bracket champion (segment-as-index × solar) equals C1 — council confirmed the bracket result.
